GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2018-04-20T18:49:03Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Adding database models to the request object?
Description: I have a question about what the request object can be used for within Express. In particular, I'm considering creating a middleware that adds a database model to the request object, something like this:

```javascript
const express = require('express');
const db = require('./databaseModel.js');

const app = express();

app.use((req, res, next) => {
    req.db = db;
    next();
}

app.get('/store', (req, res) => {
    req.db.getAllStoreItems()
    .then(storeItems => res.send(storeItems))
    .catch(error => res.sendStatus(500));
}
```

Is this an appropriate use of the request object? I'm considering this approach because it will make it easier to test my route controllers (I can just pass in a mocked database without needing to monkey patch the models), but I haven't seen this usage pattern much online so I'm not sure if there are performance implications/other gotchas that I'm not considering.

Thanks for the help!
